Inspect sparse matrix metadata

Source: R/sparse.R
sparse_info.Rd

Inspect sparse matrix metadata

Usage

sparse_info(x)

Arguments

x

A cudasparse matrix.

Value

A named list containing shape, nnz, density, format, actual device, and backend.

Examples

sparse_info(cuda_sparse(diag(3), device = "cpu"))
#> $shape
#> [1] 3 3
#> 
#> $nnz
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $density
#> [1] 0.3333333
#> 
#> $format
#> [1] "csr"
#> 
#> $device
#> [1] "cpu"
#> 
#> $backend
#> [1] "Matrix"
#> 
#> $provenance_schema
#> [1] "cudaverse-stage/1"
#> 
#> $compute_device
#> [1] "cpu"
#>
